comparison: Matched control on identical source/tasks/seed/budgets passed ring16 (suffix 26/5). Off-ladder diagnostics (no credit): gaussian1d_stability still FAIL but stationary 2->14/72, shifted hold 0->6/24, std_ratio .662->.865 (falsifier std_ratio<.8 not triggered), cdf_ks .321->.127 (>.05), mean_err .255->.312; mode_hold never idles (0/1200) and is unchanged FAIL (suffix 3/5).
conclusion: Opt-in generator idle rule, generator_idle_se=1.0 on the BCAP leader (seed 0): 5/6 Tier 1. ring16_acquisition regresses PASS->FAIL (terminal suffix 0/5, final component_covariance_error 3.09991 vs <=.85; control .496567) after skipping only 5/1600 G steps; Tier 2 BLOCKED. Idle fraction: gaussian1d_smoke 42.9%, ae_gan_hold 25.6%, five_word_joint_smoke 54.6%, two_pole 1.2%, unused_token_hold 0%. Registered repair criterion not met.
hypothesis: Skipping the G/prior step while the critic's paired real-fake gap is within one standard error of zero stops the constant-rate BCAP leader drifting during holds, repairing gaussian1d_stability and mode_hold without losing any control pass.
next_action: Keep generator_idle_se opt-in (default None); do not adopt. The 1-SE rule fires about half the time on easy 1D/word holds and almost never on ring or mode_hold, so it cannot repair mode_hold; a revision needs a different idle signal, registered as a new structural idea with a fresh control.
